scope: Historical source comparison of inspector, selection toolbar, left toolbar, top bar, layout and text editor; current rendered reachability across all 13 registered object types and selected regression scenarios.

findings.issue: Lock/unlock became hard to reach and saved locked objects could be unselectable
findings.status: Fixed in PR 528; browser recovery test rerun

findings.issue: Saved appearances and shared styles from other boards disappeared from the filtered template library
findings.status: Restored separate filtered libraries under Style

findings.issue: Text children under a free-form parent had no contextual tab, hiding Child order
findings.status: Child order available under Arrange when no contextual tab exists

findings.issue: Standalone legacy matrixCell objects could be classified as Shape, hiding multi-cell matrix controls
findings.status: matrixCell flag explicitly resolves to Matrix

findings.issue: Mixed non-text object and connector selection could hide Style and Text for the connector
findings.status: Selected connectors now contribute to tab capabilities

findings.issue: Visible fallback tab could disagree with the tab used by portalled tool groups
findings.status: Canonical tab synchronized to the visible selection

findings.issue: Select-whole-chart action was inside a header hidden in embedded mode
findings.status: Restored under Radial for a selected sector

findings.issue: Docked inspectors inherited floating-panel height caps on small screens
findings.status: Properties body owns scrolling; inner inspector height cap removed

findings.issue: React Flow selection was toggled again by the connector click handler, undoing additive selection
findings.status: Use the event edge pre-click selection snapshot; regression checks addition and removal

findings.issue: Legacy edges without data caused a fresh store snapshot on every render and an infinite rendering loop
findings.status: Move empty fallback outside the store subscription; mixed-selection fixture verifies no runtime errors

movedNotDeleted.Move before/after sibling: Child order / Move earlier and Move later
movedNotDeleted.Move shape toolbar: Intentionally removed when tools docked; no longer a floating toolbar
movedNotDeleted.Child and Sibling: Contextual tab, or More for plain text/sticky objects
movedNotDeleted.Geometry and layout: Table/Matrix/Radial/Diagram or Arrange according to object
movedNotDeleted.Connections: Style appearance, Text labels, Arrange paths

verification: run-control-audit-smoke.mjs: registered object types, mixed selections, child reorder, cross-board libraries and narrow viewport
run-properties-tabs-smoke.mjs: template/table and inherited List/Mind map/Tree/Radial controls
run-sidebar-text-tools-smoke.mjs: font/size/color/highlight/link panels and preserved Sanskrit selection
run-unlock-controls-smoke.mjs: selection, recovery, unlock-all, saved state
limits: Literal label counts are not counts of distinct controls. Browser tests check representative fixtures and key actions; they do not prove every parameter combination or every production board. Audio and junction retain their existing limited capabilities; legacy mindmap nodes migrate to shapes.
